transcript.text: I need to raise an urgent finding before we finalize the caching policy. While debugging an unrelated authentication issue this afternoon, I confirmed that two customer tenants can use the same project slug. The current unscoped project-key cache policy could therefore return one tenant's recommendation response to another tenant. I have not filed the security finding yet. My application recommendation is to use a cache key containing both tenant ID and project key, and to require a security isolation test before launch.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During a failover rehearsal this morning, I measured that DNS and service recovery take 12 minutes, while the origin database's protection limit permits serving cached responses for exactly 20 minutes before requests must stop. Because the 20-minute limit covers the measured recovery period, my reliability recommendation is to serve stale cached responses during an origin outage with a maximum stale window of exactly 20 minutes. I have not updated the launch runbook yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Cache key will be scoped to include both tenant ID and project key to prevent cross-tenant data leakage.
Security isolation test must be completed and passed before production launch.
Failover mode set to serve stale cached responses during origin outage with a maximum stale window of 20 minutes.
Launch runbook must be updated to reflect the serve-stale failover policy and 20-minute max stale window before sign-off.
Security finding must be formally filed before launch proceeds.
